decisions.rationale: For ordered bounds, selecting the median of low, value, and high implements inclusive clamping; the declared suite passed and diff check was clean.
The candidate replaced case-insensitive sorting with case-sensitive sorting, violating the specification; the declared test failed.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit, directly violating the inclusive-boundary requirement; the boundary test failed.
The candidate test was changed to expect false for is_package_ready(True), contradicting the specification, and the committed suite failed.

strategy_update: Prioritized exact specification-to-diff comparison, then used every declared check to distinguish valid implementations from specification and test regressions.
